08.03.2022

 

1. SOUTH CAUCASUS

 

: The Azerbaijani Defense Ministry this morning (9:56AM, Baku time) again accused[1] the Armenian side of firing at its positions on the Line of Contact with Nagorno-Karabakh and the Armenian-Azerbaijani state border. Members of illegal Armenian armed detachments located in the territory of Azerbaijan, where the Russian peacekeepers are temporarily stationed, fired with weapons of various calibers at positions of the Azerbaijan Army in the direction of the settlement of Papravend [PaprYvYnd] in A dam district at 6:45PM on March 7. In addition, the Armenian Armed Forces also fired at positions of the Azerbaijan Army in the direction of the settlement of Kilid in Ordubad district of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic on the state border at 7:30AM on March 8. The units of the Azerbaijan Army stationed in these directions took adequate retaliatory measures. The situation in these directions is currently stable, the units of the Azerbaijan Army fully control the operational situation , it wrote.

 

In turn (11:10AM, Yerevan time), the Armenian Defence Ministry described[2] this report as another disinformation . This information does not correspond to reality. (&) The situation on the Armenian-Azerbaijani border is relatively stable and is under the full control of Armenia s Armed Forces , it said.

 

In parallel (11:13AM, local time), the Nagorno-Karabakh Defence Army described[3] the report of the Azerbaijani Defence Ministry as an attempt to cover up its own ceasefire violations .

 

: Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev will reportedly pay a visit to Turkey on March 10. According to local media reports[4], Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdo an announced it today.

 

: Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan will pay a working visit to France on March 8-9. The Prime Minister will meet with French President Emmanuel Macron. The leaders of the two countries will then take part in the conference Ambitions: Armenia-France in Paris. During the event, members of the Armenian and French Governments will discuss issues related to development and expansion of cooperation in various fields. Prime Minister Pashinyan and President Macron will deliver remarks at the conference , the press service of the Armenian Prime Minister announced[5] this afternoon.

 

According to the schedule[6] published by L Elysée, the meeting between Emmanuel Macron and Nikol Pashinyan is scheduled for tomorrow at 4PM (Paris time), while the event Ambitions France-Arménie is due to start at 5PM (Paris time).

 

: Spokesman for the Turkish Foreign Ministry Tanju Bilgiç today commented[7] on participation of Armenian Foreign Minister Ararat Mirzoyan in the Antalya Diplomacy Forum. We welcome the statement of the Spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Armenia regarding participation of Armenian Foreign Minister Ararat Mirzoyan in the Antalya Diplomatic Forum to be held on March 11-13, 2022. Such mutual steps will contribute to increasing the dialogue between the two countries and developing confidence-building measures in line with efforts aimed at full normalisation of relations , he said.

 

: Head of the Russian community of Nagorno-Karabakh Alexander Bordov described as historic the visit paid by Bishop Savvaty of Bronnitsy[8] to the entity in February. According to local reports[9], Vicar of the Patriarch of Moscow and all Rus', Chairman of the Synodal Department for Relations with the Armed Forces and Law Enforcement Agencies Bishop Savvaty of Bronnitsy visited Nagorno-Karabakh on the occasion of the Defender of the Fatherland Day celebrated on February 23. This was the first visit of such a high-ranking clergyman from the Russian Orthodox Church to Nagorno-Karabakh , Alexander Bordov said, adding that Bishop Savvaty on February 23 blessed the military personnel of the Russian Peacekeeping Contingent and representatives of the Russian community of Nagorno-Karabakh . According to him, a divine liturgy was held in the Russian Orthodox church of the Nativity in Nagorno-Karabakh built last year on the territory of the Russian military town near Stepanakert.

 

: Nagorno-Karabakh Ombudsman G. Stepanyan today (6:10PM, local time) indicated[10] that the entity was today deprived of gas supplies due to damage caused to the main gas pipeline coming from the Republic of Armenia to Artsakh . As a result of investigations carried out by the staff of the Artsakh Human Rights Defender and discussions with law enforcement bodies, it turned out that the gas pipeline was damaged in the area under the control of the Azerbaijani Armed Forces. The specialists of the company Artsakhgaz and representatives of law enforcement bodies of Artsakh cannot clearly state whether the accident took place because of technical reasons or as a result of actions of the Azerbaijani side, as the Azerbaijani side prevents representatives of law enforcement bodies and specialists of the gas supply company from accessing the place of the incident. At the moment, restoration works are not being carried out due to obstacles created by the Azerbaijani side. Representatives of the Russian peacekeeping troops in Artsakh have been informed about the accident (&) and negotiations are underway to start repair works. Obstructing the resumption of gas supplies shows the intention of the Azerbaijani side to cause problems in the humanitarian sphere and to disrupt normal life in Artsakh , he wrote.

 

This evening, Armenia s Ombudsperson K. Grigoryan also published the following message[11]on the matter: Gas supplies from Armenia to Artsakh have been stopped for almost 24h. Till now the Azerbaijani side doesn t allow access of professionals to the place of the alleged accident. Given the weather conditions, this is a criminal behavior aggravating the humanitarian situation on the ground .

 

: Following its press release[12](with photos) confirming severe damage caused by air strikes to the building of the Honorary Consulate of the Republic of Azerbaijan in Kharkiv on March 6, the Azerbaijani Foreign Ministry today also indicated[13] that due to the situation in Ukraine, Azerbaijani diplomats working in the capital Kyiv were transferred to the Ukrainian city of Lviv (..) where they will continue to perform their duties, including on issues relating to evacuations of Azerbaijani citizens from Ukraine . In another press release[14], it today also indicated that a total of 4,375 Azerbaijani citizens (including 1,237 in the past 24 hours) were evacuated from Ukraine to Azerbaijan, including 2,298 people evacuated with charter flights and 2,077 by land .

 

2. CRISIS IN GEORGIA

 

: Georgia s State Security Service today published a statement[15] on reports and concerns related to possible influx of Russian citizens into Georgia in the context of sanctions hitting Russia of the war in Ukraine. We would like to respond to the recent deliberate disinformation on massive and uncontrolled flow of foreign citizens to Georgia, in particular of citizens of the Russian Federation and Belarus. The public is being concerned about presence of so-called diversionists, terrorism-related groups and others among travellers entering Georgia. We would like to state with full responsibility that the current security situation in the country is under total control. The State Security Service, together with other relevant authorities, is actively carrying out all necessary measures in order to reduce possible risks and challenges, as well as to monitor all individuals staying in the country who may represent a potential risk. As a result of implemented measures, the security situation in the country remains peaceful and safe. We do not observe signs that citizens of the Russian Federation, Belarus and other foreign countries attempt to carry out activities that pose risks to the country s security. In the recent period, the number of travellers entering Georgia does not exceed the figures of the same period in previous years. Georgia upholds the sovereign right of a foreign citizen to enter the territory of the country in full compliance with the legislation, in accordance with the existing risks and challenges , it said.

 

: Chief of the Radiation, Chemical, and Biological Defence Troops of the Russian Armed Forces Igor Kirillov yesterday gave a press conference dedicated to the 30 biological laboratories that worked with pathogens of dangerous infections operating on the territory of Ukraine as part of joint programs with the Pentagon . Following several remarks on Ukraine, he also mentioned the R. Lugar Center for Public Health Research in Georgia and reiterated that the African swine fever, which has been actively circulating since 2007, was developed in a laboratory in Georgia . We believe that in 2007 a strain of African swine fever with increased contagiousness was elaborated in a Georgian biological laboratory subordinated to the Pentagon. Its spread caused significant economic damage to a number of states, including Ukraine and Poland, and excluded them from a number of pork exporters , the news agencies yesterday quoted[16]him as saying.

 

: This morning (8:42AM, local time), the Abkhaz authorities indicated[17] that they registered 98 additional COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours (for a total of 298 tests). The total number of infected persons in Abkhazia now stands at 52,502. A total of 47,315 patients already recovered, while 659 people have died (+1 in the past 24 hours). The South Ossetian authorities did not publish any updates today.

08.03.2022

 

1. SOUTH CAUCASUS

 

: The Azerbaijani Defense Ministry this morning (9:56AM, Baku time) again accused[1] the Armenian side of firing at its positions on the Line of Contact with Nagorno-Karabakh and the Armenian-Azerbaijani state border. Members of illegal Armenian armed detachments located in the territory of Azerbaijan, where the Russian peacekeepers are temporarily stationed, fired with weapons of various calibers at positions of the Azerbaijan Army in the direction of the settlement of Papravend [PaprYvYnd] in A dam district at 6:45PM on March 7. In addition, the Armenian Armed Forces also fired at positions of the Azerbaijan Army in the direction of the settlement of Kilid in Ordubad district of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic on the state border at 7:30AM on March 8. The units of the Azerbaijan Army stationed in these directions took adequate retaliatory measures. The situation in these directions is currently stable, the units of the Azerbaijan Army fully control the operational situation , it wrote.

 

In turn (11:10AM, Yerevan time), the Armenian Defence Ministry described[2] this report as another disinformation . This information does not correspond to reality. (&) The situation on the Armenian-Azerbaijani border is relatively stable and is under the full control of Armenia s Armed Forces , it said.

 

In parallel (11:13AM, local time), the Nagorno-Karabakh Defence Army described[3] the report of the Azerbaijani Defence Ministry as an attempt to cover up its own ceasefire violations .

 

: Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev will reportedly pay a visit to Turkey on March 10. According to local media reports[4], Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdo an announced it today.

 

: Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan will pay a working visit to France on March 8-9. The Prime Minister will meet with French President Emmanuel Macron. The leaders of the two countries will then take part in the conference Ambitions: Armenia-France in Paris. During the event, members of the Armenian and French Governments will discuss issues related to development and expansion of cooperation in various fields. Prime Minister Pashinyan and President Macron will deliver remarks at the conference , the press service of the Armenian Prime Minister announced[5] this afternoon.

 

According to the schedule[6] published by L Elysée, the meeting between Emmanuel Macron and Nikol Pashinyan is scheduled for tomorrow at 4PM (Paris time), while the event Ambitions France-Arménie is due to start at 5PM (Paris time).

 

: Spokesman for the Turkish Foreign Ministry Tanju Bilgiç today commented[7] on participation of Armenian Foreign Minister Ararat Mirzoyan in the Antalya Diplomacy Forum. We welcome the statement of the Spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Armenia regarding participation of Armenian Foreign Minister Ararat Mirzoyan in the Antalya Diplomatic Forum to be held on March 11-13, 2022. Such mutual steps will contribute to increasing the dialogue between the two countries and developing confidence-building measures in line with efforts aimed at full normalisation of relations , he said.

 

: Head of the Russian community of Nagorno-Karabakh Alexander Bordov described as historic the visit paid by Bishop Savvaty of Bronnitsy[8] to the entity in February. According to local reports[9], Vicar of the Patriarch of Moscow and all Rus', Chairman of the Synodal Department for Relations with the Armed Forces and Law Enforcement Agencies Bishop Savvaty of Bronnitsy visited Nagorno-Karabakh on the occasion of the Defender of the Fatherland Day celebrated on February 23. This was the first visit of such a high-ranking clergyman from the Russian Orthodox Church to Nagorno-Karabakh , Alexander Bordov said, adding that Bishop Savvaty on February 23 blessed the military personnel of the Russian Peacekeeping Contingent and representatives of the Russian community of Nagorno-Karabakh . According to him, a divine liturgy was held in the Russian Orthodox church of the Nativity in Nagorno-Karabakh built last year on the territory of the Russian military town near Stepanakert.

 

: Nagorno-Karabakh Ombudsman G. Stepanyan today (6:10PM, local time) indicated[10] that the entity was today deprived of gas supplies due to damage caused to the main gas pipeline coming from the Republic of Armenia to Artsakh . As a result of investigations carried out by the staff of the Artsakh Human Rights Defender and discussions with law enforcement bodies, it turned out that the gas pipeline was damaged in the area under the control of the Azerbaijani Armed Forces. The specialists of the company Artsakhgaz and representatives of law enforcement bodies of Artsakh cannot clearly state whether the accident took place because of technical reasons or as a result of actions of the Azerbaijani side, as the Azerbaijani side prevents representatives of law enforcement bodies and specialists of the gas supply company from accessing the place of the incident. At the moment, restoration works are not being carried out due to obstacles created by the Azerbaijani side. Representatives of the Russian peacekeeping troops in Artsakh have been informed about the accident (&) and negotiations are underway to start repair works. Obstructing the resumption of gas supplies shows the intention of the Azerbaijani side to cause problems in the humanitarian sphere and to disrupt normal life in Artsakh , he wrote.

 

This evening, Armenia s Ombudsperson K. Grigoryan also published the following message[11]on the matter: Gas supplies from Armenia to Artsakh have been stopped for almost 24h. Till now the Azerbaijani side doesn t allow access of professionals to the place of the alleged accident. Given the weather conditions, this is a criminal behavior aggravating the humanitarian situation on the ground .

 

: Following its press release[12](with photos) confirming severe damage caused by air strikes to the building of the Honorary Consulate of the Republic of Azerbaijan in Kharkiv on March 6, the Azerbaijani Foreign Ministry today also indicated[13] that due to the situation in Ukraine, Azerbaijani diplomats working in the capital Kyiv were transferred to the Ukrainian city of Lviv (..) where they will continue to perform their duties, including on issues relating to evacuations of Azerbaijani citizens from Ukraine . In another press release[14], it today also indicated that a total of 4,375 Azerbaijani citizens (including 1,237 in the past 24 hours) were evacuated from Ukraine to Azerbaijan, including 2,298 people evacuated with charter flights and 2,077 by land .

 

2. CRISIS IN GEORGIA

 

: Georgia s State Security Service today published a statement[15] on reports and concerns related to possible influx of Russian citizens into Georgia in the context of sanctions hitting Russia of the war in Ukraine. We would like to respond to the recent deliberate disinformation on massive and uncontrolled flow of foreign citizens to Georgia, in particular of citizens of the Russian Federation and Belarus. The public is being concerned about presence of so-called diversionists, terrorism-related groups and others among travellers entering Georgia. We would like to state with full responsibility that the current security situation in the country is under total control. The State Security Service, together with other relevant authorities, is actively carrying out all necessary measures in order to reduce possible risks and challenges, as well as to monitor all individuals staying in the country who may represent a potential risk. As a result of implemented measures, the security situation in the country remains peaceful and safe. We do not observe signs that citizens of the Russian Federation, Belarus and other foreign countries attempt to carry out activities that pose risks to the country s security. In the recent period, the number of travellers entering Georgia does not exceed the figures of the same period in previous years. Georgia upholds the sovereign right of a foreign citizen to enter the territory of the country in full compliance with the legislation, in accordance with the existing risks and challenges , it said.

 

: Chief of the Radiation, Chemical, and Biological Defence Troops of the Russian Armed Forces Igor Kirillov yesterday gave a press conference dedicated to the 30 biological laboratories that worked with pathogens of dangerous infections operating on the territory of Ukraine as part of joint programs with the Pentagon . Following several remarks on Ukraine, he also mentioned the R. Lugar Center for Public Health Research in Georgia and reiterated that the African swine fever, which has been actively circulating since 2007, was developed in a laboratory in Georgia . We believe that in 2007 a strain of African swine fever with increased contagiousness was elaborated in a Georgian biological laboratory subordinated to the Pentagon. Its spread caused significant economic damage to a number of states, including Ukraine and Poland, and excluded them from a number of pork exporters , the news agencies yesterday quoted[16]him as saying.

 

: This morning (8:42AM, local time), the Abkhaz authorities indicated[17] that they registered 98 additional COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours (for a total of 298 tests). The total number of infected persons in Abkhazia now stands at 52,502. A total of 47,315 patients already recovered, while 659 people have died (+1 in the past 24 hours). The South Ossetian authorities did not publish any updates today.
